{{Top|leg}}
'''Master of the Plow''' was an accolade bestowed upon [[Kentra]] who were considered to be a master in the one of the [[Species/Legends|species']] three disciplines; [[Sword, Plow, and Spirit]]. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grumman Mogotah]] was a Master of the Plow.<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|2|The Prophecy}}</ref>
